headline: Sensex trades flat, Nifty holds above 23,250 as Tata stocks rally
why: Markets absorbed the expected US rate hike, helping Nifty stay above 23,250.
Realty and pharma sectors surged over 1.5% while IT faced selling pressure.
Easing global oil prices and US yields provided support to broader market sentiment.
whatHappening: SEBI is reviewing broker concerns regarding new UPI transaction fees and MDR charges.
NSE IPO saw a 0.43x subscription on its first day, driven primarily by NIIs.
TVS noted a 22% growth in premium motorcycles as the two-wheeler market shifts up.
India's construction equipment exports are expected to pass 20,000 units in FY27.

stocksInNews.sources: Tata group stocks rose on listing hopes and Chandra's extension
Stock in focus amid UPI fee debates and market movement
Reported 22% growth in premium motorcycle sales
IPO subscribed 0.43 times on Day 1 with high NII participation

summary:
Indian equities remained stable as Nifty held above 23,250 despite an expected US rate hike.
Realty, pharma, and Tata group stocks drove gains, offsetting weakness in IT shares.
